description: YAML to JSON converter — Offline YAML 1.2 to JSON (yaml=) or JSON to YAML (json=) conversion with clear line-numbered parse errors. Handles block and flow collections, quoted, plain and block scalars (| and > with chomping), anchors, aliases, merge keys and multi-document streams; warns on duplicate keys. Optional indent= 1-8. Max 200000 chars. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_yaml_json
